description: This file contains shell functions related to firmware upgrade checks, specifically verifying image signatures and metadata. It includes functions for signature validation ('fwtool_check_signature') and image compatibility validation ('fwtool_check_image'), utilizing external tools like 'fwtool' and 'ucert'.

methods.name: fwtool_check_signature
methods.description: Checks the signature of the firmware image using 'fwtool' and 'ucert', ensuring the image is signed and valid.

methods.name: fwtool_check_image
methods.description: Validates the firmware image's metadata and compatibility with the device, using 'fwtool', JSON parsing, and device information.
